verdict.rationale: Vanta's documentation says it runs automated tests against integrated systems such as AWS, Azure, Okta and GitHub (40+ AWS resources alone) and continuously monitors them to keep you compliant beyond the annual audit. Failing tests are queryable through the List Tests API and the MCP server, which can also generate remediation plans. All of this evidence is vendor-authored, and no source states how quickly a failure surfaces. Missing for 10: documented test cadence or detection latency backing the 'within hours' claim, independent or hands-on corroboration of continuous test execution.
